item.title: Self-Hosted Network Traffic Analysis: ntopng vs Arkime vs Zeek (2026)
item.description: Network traffic analysis tools capture, index, and visualize network flows to help administrators identify performance issues, security threats, and capacity bottlenecks. Self-hosted traffic analysis platforms give you complete visibility into your network without sending flow data to external monitoring services.
